title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Section_1
doc_notes: This document is an FBI case file (62-HQ-83894) containing investigative records, correspondence, and newspaper clippings regarding UAP sightings between 1947 and 1948. / This document is an FBI case file (62-HQ-83894) containing investigative reports, teletypes, and correspondence regarding UAP sightings between 1947 and 1948, characterized by heavy administrative routing and stamps.

incidents.summary: A circular metal disc, 18 inches in diameter, crashed into a church yard in Grafton, WI, making a swishing noise and a mild explosion.
incidents.quote: A Catholic priest at Grafton, Wis., said tonight that a round, metal disc... had crashed into his parish yard

incidents.summary: A student pilot reported seeing a saucer-shaped object traveling at high speed over the Northeast section of Washington, D.C.
incidents.quote: looked like an orange lamp bulb without the socket

incidents.summary: A flaming object dropped in the street in front of a house in Omaha, Nebraska, and was examined by the witness.
incidents.quote: witnessed a flaming object which dropped in street

incidents.summary: Witness reported seeing a flying saucer in the air at the same level as searchlight beams near Lake St. Clair.
incidents.quote: I have also seen a flying saucer

incidents.summary: Approximately 12 flying discs reported passing over Darlington, SC.
incidents.quote: ABOUT 12 SO-CALL FLYING DISCS PASSED OVER DARLINGTON SC

incidents.summary: A flying disc reported recovered near Roswell, New Mexico, described as hexagonal and suspended from a balloon.
incidents.quote: OBJECT PURPORTING TO BE A FLYING DISC WAS RE COVERED NEAR ROSWELL, NEW MEXICO

incidents.summary: A circular disc observed whirring in the air with fire spouting from sides, landing in Shreveport, LA.
incidents.quote: DISC WHIRLING WHEN SEEN IN AIR AND FIRE SEEN SPOUTING FROM SIDES

incidents.summary: A flying disc reported landed in Burbank, CA, and burst into flame.
incidents.quote: a 'flying disc' had landed in or near Burbank and had been seen to burst into flame

incidents.summary: Recovery of a metallic, disc-shaped object in North Hollywood, CA, reported to have landed and caught fire.
incidents.explanation: Determined to be a hoax by military authorities.
incidents.quote: a so-called "flying disc" had landed in the vicinity of Radford and Magnolia Streets

incidents.summary: Report of a flying disc landing on a roof in Seattle, WA.
incidents.explanation: Determined to be a hoax/non-flying object.
incidents.quote: FLYING DISK HAD LANDED ON HER ROOF ABOUT NINE FORTY TWO PM LAST NIGHT

incidents.summary: Observation of metallic fragments and small fires on a lawn in West Rindge, NH.
incidents.explanation: Possibly lining from a jet turbo plane or V-2 bomb.
incidents.quote: LITTLE CURLS OF SMOKE, WHICH ON INSPECTION DISCLOSED SMALL BURNED SPOTS

incidents.summary: Observation of two round objects moving at high speed over the Grand Canyon.
incidents.quote: saw two round objects going at inconceivable speeds, straight down

incidents.summary: Observation of ten flying discs in formation over Bakersfield, CA.
incidents.quote: saw ten articles flying from the South to the North

incidents.summary: Observation of three discs flying over Portland, OR.
incidents.quote: saw three flat round discs, having a white color to them
